OGS-001.name: Annie, Fiery
OGS-001.rulesText: Your spells and abilities deal 1 Bonus Damage.

OGS-002.name: Firestorm
OGS-002.rulesText: Deal 3 to all enemy units at a battlefield.

OGS-003.name: Incinerate
OGS-003.rulesText:
[Action]
Deal 2 to a unit at a battlefield.

OGS-004.name: Master Yi, Meditative
OGS-004.rulesText: While you have 8+ runes, I have +4 [M].

OGS-005.name: Zephyr Sage
OGS-005.flavorText:
"A true master is an eternal student."
—Master Yi

OGS-006.name: Lux, Illuminated
OGS-006.rulesText: When you play a spell that costs [5] or more, give me +3 [M] this turn.

OGS-007.name: Garen, Rugged
OGS-007.flavorText: "Fear is the first of many foes."

OGS-008.name: Gentlemen's Duel
OGS-008.rulesText:
[Action]
Give a friendly unit +3 [M] this turn. Then choose an enemy unit. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.
OGS-008.flavorText: A proper and formal way to kill your enemies.

OGS-009.name: Master Yi, Honed
OGS-009.flavorText: "The focused mind can pierce through stone."

OGS-010.name: Annie, Stubborn
OGS-010.rulesText: When you play me, return a spell from your trash to your hand.

OGS-011.name: Flash
OGS-011.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Move up to 2 friendly units to base.
OGS-011.flavorText: It's not running away. It's strategic repositioning.

OGS-012.name: Blast of Power
OGS-012.rulesText:
[Action]
Kill a unit at a battlefield.

OGS-014.name: Lux, Crownguard
OGS-014.flavorText: "I've been hiding my light long enough."

OGS-015.name: Recruit the Vanguard
OGS-015.flavorText:
"My heart and sword always for Demacia."
—Garen

OGS-016.name: Vanguard Attendant
OGS-016.flavorText: Even the Vanguard needs a first line of defense.

OGS-017.name: Annie, Dark Child
OGS-017.rulesText: At the end of your turn, ready up to 2 runes.

OGS-018.name: Tibbers
OGS-018.rulesText: When you play me, deal 3 to all units at battlefields.

OGS-019.name: Master Yi, Wuju Bladesman
OGS-019.rulesText: While a friendly unit defends alone, it gets +2 [M].

OGS-020.name: Highlander
OGS-020.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Choose a friendly unit. The next time it would die this turn, heal it, exhaust it, and recall it instead.

OGS-021.name: Lux, Lady of Luminosity
OGS-021.rulesText: When you play a spell that costs [5] or more, draw 1.

OGS-023.name: Garen, Might of Demacia
OGS-023.rulesText: When you conquer, if you have 4+ units at that battlefield, draw 2.
